notes.title: Patch Notes - Feb 23, 2025
notes.notes:
Good evening, survivors. Marvin here.

The regular update has been released. I'd like to provide a more detailed account of the changes and additions included in this update.








{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/faa4d050b7d5fb887029eec777e930a6e0cf615f.png
When survivors have specific items exceeding 1000, the inventory will now display them as 999+.










{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/8ae6aa9db693a599ebf338bd87cc140c668bb688.png
The HUD color for Dash has been changed to gold.










{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/f5448eab7cbb89a114e957ca1bc69dc58bfe92fe.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/7f0350bb9891d930ca2a3ec75a570c679be9a63a.gif
Agility now affects the cooldown of Dash. Each point of agility decreases the cooldown by 0.005 seconds, meaning that for every 1 point of agility, the time you have to wait before using Dash again is reduced by 0.005 seconds.










{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/2f558ebc32270440f1129bf8d13fb133ba8ad03f.png
The store's name has been changed: JY's Awesome Clothing → YK's Lit Wardrobe.












{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/e6c45e727ac4ac4a006c5ced59db97617107cd9a.png
A bathroom has been added inside The Mighty Hawk. (Survivors can't take a bath yet.)












{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/fd9ec4605eb165ed89a9fb0496be9f0b653e32e8.png
A soap dispenser has been added to the bathroom in Setsuka's house.












{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/339d99f7e7467994fa22ecc298bf77d7617d3fb3.png
Ezraella's surname has been renamed to Nabokov, as the previous one was applied in error and did not align with our original intent for her character.











The Explorer's Guide to the Whispering Sunrise Forest now includes additional phrases
Before: "Getting warm in front of a bonfire outside in safety offers a cozy feeling and releases dopamine. Just remember not to fall asleep; hypothermia awaits."

After: "Getting warm in front of a bonfire offers a cozy feeling and releases dopamine. In the wilderness of Lumainaho, outside of villages in winter, the fatal frost will freeze your blood. Then, your heart will shatter, unable to withstand the extreme cold. So get warm by any bonfire. It will protect you from freezing to death. Just remember not to fall asleep; hypothermia awaits."











A new phrase has been added to the system message
Before: "The frost embraces you with hands of death."

After: "The frost embraces you with hands of death. Your speed has slowed down, and your HP is continuously damaged."











Japanese Translation Improvements
🎌 Common
フロすたリダ → フロスタリダ


🎌 Uncle Winston (to have a more testosterone-fueled tone)
おい！久しぶりだな！中に入って来いよ。 → おい！ 久しぶりだな！ 中に入れよ。

家族が出かけた後、時々、お前の家を掃除することがあるんだぞ。 → お前の家族が出た後、たまに家を掃除してやるんだぞ。 

ああ、忘れろよ。用心しなきゃな。 → あ、忘れろよ。用心しなきゃな。 

自宅のようにくつろいでください。私は自宅に向かいます。 → 自宅みたいにくつろいでくれ。俺は自宅に向かうから。 

よぉ、ちび。 → よう、ローズさん。 

おい、元気かい、子供。→ おい、起きてたんだな。 

いや、 Pはもう２時間前から外にいるよ。→ いや、Pはもう２時間前から外だぞ。 

了解、後で立ち寄ってくれ。 彼にあなたが来たことを伝えておく。 → 了解、後で立ち寄ってくれ。彼に来たこと伝えとくからな。 

おい、キッド。→ おい、友達。 

調子はどう？ → 調子どうだ？ 

これ、見せてあげるよ。→ これ、見せてやるよ。 

よっしゃ、これがある。→ よっしゃ、これあるぞ。 

バイバイ。 → またな。 

凍った道に気をつけてね。→ 凍った道に気をつけとけ。 

パンドゥによろしく。→ パンドゥによろしく言っとけ。 

ごめん、もっとカネが必要だ。 → 悪いけど、もっとカネが必要だ。 

無料でサービスを提供することはできないよ、ちび。 → 無料でサービスはできないよ。 

売りたいけど、できないんだ。→ 売りたいけど、できねぇんだ。 

素敵じゃない。→ よくありません。 

キラキラしてて、カッコいいでしょ？ → キラキラしてて、カッコいいだろ？ 

武器を強化するんだ、ちび？ がんばれよ！ → 武器を強化するんだ？ がんばれよ！ 

がんばってね。 → がんばれ。 

素敵。→ お前、カッコいいな。 

狩りの準備はしてる？ → 狩りの準備できてる？ 

誰か相手してるの？ → 誰か相手してるな？ 

賢明な選択ね。 → 賢明な選択だな。 



🎌 Ember
こんばんは、カワイイ子。 顔が青いよ。大丈夫？ → こんばんは、可愛い子。顔が青いよ。大丈夫？






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/7c95f1d1a98e487bee4f5740749a5cc870ca3a9a.png
The 1st Anniversary Celebration has ended
Also FFN Steam group access has been converted to public. Feel free to join.







About the Next Update
We might tell you more about it and our future within a month. Perhaps we'll talk about something more serious.





We always appreciate your support.

Cheers,
FFN Team

notes.title: Regular Friday Night Update - Nov 25, 2024
notes.notes:
Good evening, survivors. This is the FFN Team.

We've just released a regular update build for your Friday nights. Here are the details:


1. HP regeneration time at the bonfire has been reduced from 12 seconds to 7 seconds.

2. Bonfire buff wait time has been reduced from 24 seconds to 7 seconds.






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/41e7c00828bf93a5d32857a1b3109bfb4b4b4192.png
3. Japanese Localization: In the Japanese version, the position (position.x) of the tutorial text displayed on the window in the opening scene has been slightly adjusted.







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/03b320b27b8ab7ca707cff96b898cbe6845d61be.png
4. In the Game Over scene, the ESC icon will appear when you die three times.








{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/9182d90e18cafa572a1aa7711ff19eb812f05709.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/ece4a324215855bd5d87501d7176e404c665e61b.png
5. If you die more than once, the following tooltips will now appear instead of "Rose has been killed" in the Game Over scene:

📖 Are you scared of the axe flashing in front of your eyes? Don't panic, don't be afraid, and quickly dash toward the killer. You might find him confused, brandishing his weapon in the air.

📖 The killer loves playing hide-and-seek. You never know when or where he'll disappear or pop up, so always keep an eye out.

📖 Some places—don't know why—but the killer never goes near.

📖 If you're determined to fight the killer, it's wise to lure him into a wide open space.

📖 A shotgun is always a great negotiator.

📖 Step 1: Dash to dodge. Step 2: Smash or shoot!

📖 The killer might be wearing a bulletproof vest... or maybe even a full bulletproof suit.

📖 If the killer's deadly swing is about to kill you, try dodging it with a dash.

📖 Dashing takes a lot of concentration and energy, so it's hard to use continuously.

📖 Some say it's mostly effective to insult a killer's mother when you encounter them.

📖 Staying in front of the bonfire for a while could keep your whole body warm for a long time. Let's count to seven while roasting a marshmallow. One, two...

📖 Reading The Fearsome British Man's Kind Tutorial: The Easiest Way to Hunt Crocodiles for Dinner might help if you ever get bitten by a crocodile or gator. You can grab a copy now from Ember.

📖 In this frosty, deep forest, unless you find a cozy spot, the freezing air—like death—will slowly drain your health. Your body will slow down and eventually freeze, so always make sure to keep warm.

📖 Food and drinks can help keep your body warm. However, drinking alcohol in the winter can lead to hypothermia or even a heart attack. Safe holidays!






Additions to Expect in the Next Update
1. New Merchant: Wranglers (Lumainaho Bison Transport Service)





We always appreciate your support.


Cheers,
FFN Team

notes.title: Moonlight Serenade: First Raid Boss Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=0L9A_vKmIoE;full][/previewyoutube]
Good evening, survivors. Marvin here.

The major update featuring our first raid boss has been released. I'd like to provide a more detailed account of the changes and additions included in this update.








{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/a7174bae19dc56f487f84f200520ee3a084421d0.gif
New Area: Lake Daphne
Survivors can now access the lakeside through dark woods crowded with the ghosts.










{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/654b3c7ad4d0cd1e57cec8216b7a6c1072b54286.gif
The First Raid Boss: Mr. Brandon
Survivors can now challenge the giant teddy bear man. To encounter him, you'll need to talk with Jane, John, Sheriff Jackson, Sunny, Ezraella, and Bianca after saving Sunny. Then, find Franklin near the abandoned Millie Bessie building in the ghost woods.











{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/5a7cdfd98c8d208481cd122babd6356e8b87cade.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/8f16198d9ba60c837d78b68678e8b7efd903d442.png
Mr. Brandon Sketch
Created by our designer AJ, drawn on July 16, 2024.











{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/7c5d3487b8dfe2a46134848213f6380327aef607.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/a453a5421a3ae2ddb51e00290957823df309d772.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/54fc38754f3b2d39230881e0defaaa2e868dbf62.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/b8a76adaa67c2d1be6677d5b2ef3f4e985f44aa1.gif
Mr. Brandon Animations
Created by our designer AJ, animated on September 20, 2024.











{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/713d2518263f15f2df39b98ab0093fccdaca0ad6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/4a9be619892d673718770a06823da0607cb3063a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/9bd6ede28db9a43ac812c228ab070c4a73e899be.png
Lake Daphne Rough Design
Created by our designer AJ on October 8, 2024.












{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/1f505510b9ddd2f58bdbce1e17d73f7922632076.png
Mr. Brandon and Rose Artwork
Created by an AI at the request of AJ, who ordered it for fun while nearly burned out from work. 













{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/93deccad03edf5aa502c8523b58ea1c0c16d8bd5.gif
Mr. Brandon uses four types of combat skills:
1. Massive Extermination








{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/bbd79c4a80c500684eb55ba74327c9b0be3d09f3.gif
2. Big and Big Log








{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/3eb1341f9696cc01f865c401c12e9e72f0b703d4.gif
3. Lumberjack







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/dba8fa291d038ecb165d55eb798f352f222bde59.gif
4. Teddy Stunner






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/da5c66d0f09b8f75479553582c564a1742cb9447.gif
Once you defeat Mr. Brandon, you can challenge him again with two difficulties: Easy and Lunatic.








{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/b32b616a325fee34f27ee9f8368efad3e9feb6cc.png
Items Dropped by Mr. Brandon: Gold Powder, Dollars, .30 Caliber, Blue Moonstone, Guillotine, Artemis, and Franklin's Aquamarine Ring.







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/0d09b204c994a82bec0ca400e732405a021153f6.jpg
New Merchant: Bob Bob
You can meet Bob Bob once you defeat Mr. Brandon. You'll need Blue Moonstones to trade with him.

Items Sold by Bob Bob: Gold Powder, .30 Caliber, Guillotine, and Artemis.






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/d1cb42d700f720d5950493569dfbbc0583bc325d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/df420bc37f2370943ef4bc217b24a16b44647a38.png
New Weapons: Guillotine, Deputy Sheriff Longinus' Automatic Rifle
Both legendary weapons will be your best friends while exploring the Whispering Sunrise Forest.



New Ammo: .30 Caliber
Required for Deputy Sheriff Longinus' Automatic Rifle.




New Perk: Blessing of Dullahan
Guillotine's special ability.




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/f541985a92d88cfff16b4980bea7a9c34887045f.jpg
New Accessory: Artemis
This legendary ring will make you a gunslinger.





New Currency: Blue Moonstone
Blue Moonstones are needed to trade with Bob Bob. Mr. Brandon drops one Blue Moonstone in Easy Raids and two Blue Moonstones in Lunatic Raids.






New Stat: Armor Penetration
Effective against heavily armored enemies, including creatures with tough hides, like crocodiles.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/177ce7e8be928d6004c913cd433210972546b498.png
New Debuff: Freeze Response
When you encounter enemies with an overwhelming level gap (+10 levels higher), your Speed, Concentration, and Evade Chance will be reduced in proportion to your Sanity.


Ways to Increase Sanity

1. Leveling up
2. Enjoying special dishes: Crocodile Omurice, Crocodile Steak, Classic Cheese Pizza
3. Defeating specific bosses: Santa Mask Suit, Mr. Brandon

💙 You can now gain 0.04 Sanity whenever you defeat Santa Mask Suit in the Nightmare.

💙 You can gain 0.08 Sanity whenever you defeat Mr. Brandon in the Easy Raid. (Not applicable in the story battle.)

💙 You can gain 0.12 Sanity whenever you defeat Mr. Brandon in the Lunatic Raid.






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/f1265b2ac9393474efa4bd135ed5ec225e0f7cf0.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/5b99f1d900d8f144c5e1a2c24d22527600c68f41.jpg
New Steam Achievements: Here's Teddy!, Moonlight Sonata







Expanded Survivors' Maximum Level to 10
A death penalty has been added: at level 10 or higher, you lose 10% of the XP needed to level up when you die. There is still no level-down system, so you don't need to worry about losing levels.








In-depth User Experience Enhancements
1. Ammo count on the UI now displays as 999+ when survivors have more than 999 rounds.

2. Reload time for shotguns now varies based on the amount of ammo already loaded.

3. Upon death, survivors now respawn at the bonfire in Huckletwain instead of returning to the Start Menu. (This change was implemented in the last update but was not previously mentioned.)





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/8aa3009dc18e8c8bf92b78f58be9e14418ee9ec8.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/544a1b06b47667e845c74005faf7927126322678.gif
4. Survivors can now adjust camera follow speed with the F5 key.

5. Whoosh sounds for melee weapons have been restored.

6. Improved hit sounds for each character when they are attacked by each weapon type.

7. Frame Optimization: Unnecessary graphic resources used in combat actions have been reduced by half, enhancing battle performance.







[previewyoutube=ZEcqHA7dbwM;full][/previewyoutube]
Fixes
1. Fixed an issue where the Damage Pop-Up had constantly floated upward to the moon.

2. Updated terminology throughout the dialogues: the term "Elk" has been replaced with "Caribou."









Additions to Expect in the Next Update
1. New Merchant: Wranglers (Lumainaho Bison Transport Service)

2. UI/UX Enhancements






We always appreciate your support. Enjoy your spooktacular Halloween.


Cheers,
FFN Team

Survivors will also meet new residents: Chloe Sangria, Elm Jackson, Ezraella, Bianca Thana, John, Jane, Sunny Herb, and Franklin Longinus.

With a hunting knife equipped, you can now gather meat, eggs, and hides from these scary creatures.

Chloe will also make you omurice or steak whenever you bring her meat or eggs! 🥩🥚













{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/42557a620dcf094ffef41b1d2e77e08a7e7ef2ee.png
Bounty Hunting

After completing a certain quest, Sheriff Jackson will reward you whenever you bring him crocodile hides. 💵










{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/d7120decfb068954d7c58ab439f66fcc438681b8.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/9c3cc8dbaef971145a6933993710b03091ab7db9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/4bfec2173d64221bb53cee906098e85f947dca18.png

The Christmas tree has been redesigned and new types have been added! 🎄












{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/6f19ea00bc280d6c4396d5f336a00e3f9f650abb.png
Inventory UI

Survivors can now check most items instantly by pressing the V key: Ammo, Miscellaneous, Quest Items, Equipped Equipment, and Worn Apparel.











{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/3365a14ca1e0b1a93225c0ac5e4f3ae56864a2cf.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/e63c0c91a9840b7d1ff35524127da0e6608dff03.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/4b545a9acad46520a390c75e3b9e8044e5d0b2e6.gif

You can now see how strong your weapons are when attacking enemies. Critical damage will be shown in red.

You can also make the Pop-Up invisible by pressing the ` key.


Additionally, firearms now have a chance to hit headshots. This chance is influenced by Agility, Concentration, and Luck. 🎯


Headshots instantly kill regular enemies and inflict 10x damage against bosses.

notes.title: Buck or Buckshot Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Good evening, survivors. Marvin here.

The major update, "Buck or Buckshot," was released a few days ago, bringing multiple new user experiences to the Friday nights. I'd like to provide a more detailed account of the changes and additions included in this update.








{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/6501716febe0f084714a67c97c625bc7f32726a0.gif

New Enemy: Saltwater Crocodiles

Our main designer, AJ, added these creatures. Initially, we had planned to introduce criminals like gangsters or thugs, but AJ wanted to expedite the update. To do this, we recycled some legacy graphic resources from our debut, Flaming Friday Night.

At first, I was opposed to the idea, "Crocodiles in the Northwestern United States? In winter? That doesn't seem appropriate." AJ replied, "This is America, so it makes sense." In the end, I was persuaded.






 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/e058317b955fd2253364803ac31dc6d7cf2b5800.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/9bed60a416a3c7d470d8c419caaa453bdb351d2a.gif

Anyway, once you get and read the crocodile hunting guide book, you'll be able to escape when bitten by them, except when your HP is gone. Their bite damage is deadly, so do your best to avoid getting bitten.









{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/ddc6bfdb54b658a2e396323494101f3a549b71b9.png

Debuff and Buffs: Frost, Bonfire, Pizza

Yeah, Rose and Pandu bolted out of the bloody house wearing nothing but the party costumes, so they must be freezing.

The frost in the wilderness continually damages you survivors and slows you down when your Frost Resistance isn't high enough.







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/5fe6a924e70f3254ccf5e02d28ee3726c8996838.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/9d521f1375bc5cdf4ead1017781537dab3978495.gif

To deal with this, grab some pizza slices and warm up by the bonfire to boost your Frost Resistance.

Of course, other methods to increase it will be added later.









{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/26edf6f5bd03cba61f50f47092af974d2643f284.png

Level and Status System Now Displayed and Available

Actually, these values have already existed since FFN EVE released. Just the Santa's lovely axe is really deadly, and Rose's HP couldn't cover it. Still can't, though.


That's right, we released Frozen Friday Night: The Eve as a Horror Action Noir Western RPG, not a casual simple game. That's why we're still constructing the night.

Then, we finally added the Seasprinkle University Student ID Card to display survivor's data.



💪 Agility
It affects increasing Evade Chance.

Agility will affect reducing cooldown of dash, and others in the future.


💪 Intelligence
It influences the amount of XP gained.

Survivor can increase Intelligence through reading most books.

Intelligence will provide additional benefits for survivors in the future, especially for Pandu.


💪 Concentration
It affects increasing Accuracy and Deadly Hit.

Concentration will provide additional benefit for survivors in the future.


💪 Endurance
It affects increasing HP, Speed, and Sanity.


💪 Speed
An essential attribute in the scary game.


💪 Strength
It affects increasing melee weapon damage.


💪 Sanity
When you encounter an enemy with an overwhelming level difference, the body may freeze if Sanity is low. That means we'll add the first raid boss battle soon.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/26feff0220f8b4aceed936c55b511cb940cbaf08.gif

💪 Luck
It affects increasing Accuracy, Deadly Hit and Evade Chance.

And Luck also affects the chance to obtain more currency or ammo from wooden crates and to discover a four-leaf clover!

You can increase Luck whenever you discover four-leaf clovers.


💪 Armor
Armor reduces damage taken. Lower Armor value reduces more damage.


💪 Frost Resistance
An essential attribute when you're exploring Whispering Sunrise Forest and when you don't want to die by heart attack while drinking like a fish in holiday seasons.


💪 Accuracy
Higher Accuracy means fewer missed attacks.


💪 Evade Chance
Higher Evade Chance means you're more likely to evade enemy attacks when you're hit.


💪 Killing Power
It affects increasing survivor's damage output.


💪 Deadly Power
It's Critical Damage.


💪 Deadly Hit
It's Critical Hit.


💪 Cruelty
It affects increasing Deadly Power.


💪 Notoriety
We'll explain about Notoriety later.







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/089b121f3f81144e8eea827dae9fd6c38daf43b8.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/78cc530b364a5d78efb90c4fb0511dc0c8a946bd.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/b97b3ca8cfe42f46ea3e97b16868323f801ba89c.gif

🔥 Level and XP
You'll gain XP whenever you defeat crocodiles or the Santa Mask Suit in nightmares, which will increase your level.


🔥 Level Up Benefits
1. Restores HP to full.
2. Increases HP slightly.
3. Increases Concentration slightly.
4. Increases Sanity slightly.
5. (If survivor is armed with a firearm) Increases Agility slightly.
6. (If survivor is armed with a melee weapon) Increases Strength slightly.


Survivors will also be able to increase Agility, Strength, and most other stats not only through leveling up but also through other means in the future.


The maximum level you can currently reach is 5.








{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/6c5ec1ac0320cffd0c5c2b7632e920d908f841d4.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/fe0c0593ec9f82ebc767c6de50461a0d611af51f.gif

Evasion (Miss) System

Survivor and enemies now have a chance to evade when they're hit. If evasion is successful, the Miss visual effects will be shown.











{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/dbd31c17bee76649d37c378d41a5737b887b31bd.gif

Ways to Restore HP

🍕 Sleeping
It's free and provides fast restoration, but you have to say hello to the Santa Mask Suit in the nightmare.

🍕 Bonfire
It's free and offers slower restoration than sleeping, but also provides the buff that increases your Frost Resistance after waiting a few seconds.

🍕 Leveling Up
It's free, but you need to gain XP.

🍕 Pizzas
Requires payment. Increases Frost Resistance as well.

🍕 First Aid Kit
Requires payment or can be found randomly in wooden crates in the woods.







Ways to Save Data

The data is saved when you move to another place, sleep, press the ESC key, or die.







Ways to Get Money

Apologies, we intended to add looting content from crocodiles and minor quests in this update. Unfortunately, we didn't!

For now, you can loot dollars only from dead gangsters and wooden crates. Still then, someone may have lost a modest amount of money for the Whispering Sunrise Forest explorer beginners.







Mute Function for BGM and SFX

We need it when recording videos for trailers.

Survivors will use it when you'd like to listen to old jazz, EDM, rock, classic, and other genres of music while hunting crocodiles.

You can also mute it when you're just doing other tasks on the internet, leaving Rose to stand in front of the bonfire, which can increase your playtime. This may help expose Frozen Friday Night: The Eve on Steam more frequently. Appreciate it in advance!

To mute BGM and SFX, simply press the ] or [ key.







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/866b05ca256e0a50e0df3b85f5d7b769086f8762.gif

Perks

We added perks for our crocodile hunters. By hunting crocodiles multiple times, you'll unlock more beneficial perks. I felt it's really easy to slain these beasts once I became crocodile hunter professional. But it's not essential tasks, so don't feel burden to earn all perks. 






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774015/5732b4d73432b01813714e819b68400298e55413.png

Steam Rich Presence Strings

Show your Steam friends what you're up to in Frozen Friday Night: The Eve, just like IG.









Additions you can expect in the next update

1. VFX and SFX for Deadly Hit




Additions you can expect in the future soon

1. Cooking over the bonfire
2. New resident
3. The first raid boss








We always appreciate your support. We'll be right back.


Cheers,
FFN Team



p.s. Leaving reviews or buying coffees for us will help expedite the release of the next update. Or, as we said, you can just mute sounds and get a rest at the bonfire while you're doing other tasks on the internet. Thank you.
